title: What is HisabDo? What is the HisabDo app?
text: HisabDo is a free, offline-first khata and ledger app for Android. It helps shopkeepers, freelancers and small business owners track money given and received, customer balances (udhar), payables and expenses, with PDF statements and reports.

title: How do I categorize an expense? How does automatic expense categorization work?
text: Automatic expense categorization is not described in the official HisabDo documentation, so it should not be treated as an available app feature. You can add a descriptive note to any expense, which makes your records more useful when you review them later.
source: https://hisabdo.app/faq (feature list; no categorization feature documented)

title: Is my financial data used to train the shared AI model?
text: No individual user's raw financial data is used as a knowledge source for the chatbot. Chatbot answers about your own balance, expenses, or revenue are always pulled live from your account through the backend, not from any shared knowledge base.

title: What is a cash flow statement?
text: A cash flow statement is a financial report that shows the money moving in and out of a business over a period of time, split into operating, investing, and financing activities. It helps you see whether a business is generating enough cash to sustain itself.

title: How do I export my expenses?
text: HisabDo generates PDF statements and reports for any customer account or time period, which you can share via WhatsApp, email or any messaging app. The official documentation does not mention CSV or Excel export.

title: What's the difference between profit and cash flow?
text: Profit is revenue minus expenses over a period, based on accounting rules, while cash flow is the actual movement of money in and out of your accounts. A business can be profitable on paper while still running low on cash if customers haven't paid yet.

title: What is profit?
text: Profit is the amount remaining after expenses are subtracted from revenue.

title: What is revenue?
text: Revenue is the total income generated from business sales or services before expenses are deducted.

title: What is an expense?
text: An expense is a cost incurred by a business while operating or generating revenue.

title: What is cash flow?
text: Cash flow represents the movement of money entering and leaving a business during a period.

title: Why should customer balances be tracked?
text: Tracking customer balances helps a business identify outstanding payments and monitor money owed by customers.

title: Why should business expenses be categorized?
text: Categorizing expenses makes financial records easier to analyze and helps identify where business money is being spent.

title: Is HisabDo free to use?
text: Yes. HisabDo is free to download and use from Google Play. Core features, including khata management, customer accounts, PDF export and backup, are available at no cost.

title: Does HisabDo work without the internet? Offline use
text: Yes. HisabDo is offline-first: you can use it as a guest without an account, and guest records stay on your device. If you sign in, supported data can sync with the cloud when you are online.

title: How do I back up and restore my records? Changing phones
text: HisabDo has a local backup feature that saves your records to the device or supported external storage, and you can restore a backup on any Android device running HisabDo. Create a backup before uninstalling or changing phones, or local records may be lost.

title: Is HisabDo available on iPhone (iOS)? Which devices are supported?
text: HisabDo is available on Android only, from Google Play, for Android 6.0 and above (8.0 or later recommended). There is no iPhone (iOS) version at the moment.

title: Which languages does HisabDo support? Urdu, English, Roman Urdu
text: HisabDo supports Urdu, English, Hindi, Arabic and Roman Urdu, and you can switch language in the app settings at any time.

title: How do I record udhar and payments in a customer's khata?
text: Each customer has a profile with their own transaction history and running balance. Record money given (udhar) or money received (payment) against that customer with the date, amount and an optional note, and the balance updates as you record it. You can share a PDF statement with the customer showing what is owed, what has been paid and the running balance.
